collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE V: FAMILY DRAMA, FEUDS AND LEADERSHIP DISPUTES (LCE-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
All sorts of real-life drama suited to Isola: parents with opinions about who their children marry, arranged matches, inheritances, feuds between families, accusations, apologies that are not enough, and arguments about who should lead.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Two families arranged a match and the pair secretly like each other: admit it, or let the families think it was their idea.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The families of (subject) and (friend) have arranged a match between them, and are making a great show of persuading them. What the families do not know is that (subject) and (friend) have been meeting in secret by the stream for half a year. What should the pair do?

choices.label: Let the Families Take the Credit

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) and (friend) confess at the family dinner. Both families are astonished, then delighted, then a little annoyed that they spent so long persuading. The wedding is planned by the end of the night.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: They pretend to be persuaded, slowly, with many sighs. The families are very pleased with themselves. At the wedding, (friend)'s grandmother gives a long speech about her own matchmaking genius. (subject) and (friend) do not look at each other in case they laugh.
